title: readSTL
body:
## readSTL

Reads one ASCII or binary STL file into polydata made of triangles. STL stores only triangle geometry, with no units or field arrays, so coordinates are in whatever unit the exporting CAD tool used. Use it for CAD or scanned surfaces to render, clip against, or probe onto; add normals for smooth shading. Schemaxis reads exactly one file (no file series).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Check the coordinate unit (millimetres versus metres) against the simulation data before combining them; nothing is converted.

Native constructor: `STLReader`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `files` | The list of files to be read by the reader. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1,"maxItems":1}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "readSTL",
  "options": {
    "files": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
